annotations.title: Official open data for a project question (ECB, World Bank, Eurostat, EU tenders, EU law ...)

description: Official figures fetched now from the body that publishes them, each with its date and link - suited to the market, macro, regulatory-calendar and literature parts of a project question: ECB key interest rates (financing cost); World Bank indicators for a country (GDP, GDP per capita, inflation, population, unemployment, access to electricity, renewable share); Eurostat household and industrial electricity prices (EU, candidates incl. Türkiye); public tenders for solar, wind, BESS, substations, roads, bridges, hospitals from TED (EU), World Bank-financed procurement (all borrower countries) and UK Find a Tender, with the buyer's published contact; job openings from public boards (ReliefWeb, Arbeitnow, Remotive) by field, seniority, country or remote; World Bank-financed projects of a country (pipeline and active: who invests in what before the tenders); company records from open registers (France Sirene, Norway Brønnøysund, US SEC EDGAR); a Romanian company by name (its CUI is found, then ANAF / courts); mining sites of a country with the oil / diesel power plants mapped near them (OpenStreetMap - off-grid PV + BESS targeting); Romanian company record, filed financials and court cases by CUI or name (ANAF, portal.just.ro); counterparty check of an e-mail, phone, website or EU VAT number (domain age, certificate, sub-domains, SPF / DMARC, VIES, LEI, OFAC / UN / UK sanctions) - write "check <e-mail / site / phone / VAT>"; EU regulations, directives and decisions by topic from EUR-Lex (Publications Office); Turkish Court of Cassation (Yargıtay) decisions by topic; a country's public holidays (construction calendar); books from Open Library; scholarly papers from OpenAlex; plus, when they fit, up to two read-only servers of the public MCP registry that Wai has reached itself (energy, engineering, GIS, weather, data, law, finance, travel, science), each table marked third-party. Write the question in plain words naming the country and the data wanted (e.g. "Romania electricity price, inflation and GDP; solar and BESS tenders; ECB rates"). Returns one table per source, a view page and a PDF report link (report_pdf) to give the user. Answer with the returned numbers, not an estimate made before the call.

question.description: the data wanted, in plain words, with the country
